//: The catalogs the Marketplace starts with (org.webosphoenix.service.packages). The Phoenix Marketplace's address and keys are not here: they come from /etc/palm/phoenix/servers.json ("catalog": url, key, root; docs/PLATFORM-CLIENT.md), the device's one configuration of the platform's servers, which the image is built with and the simulator points at this computer (server/marketplace: bin/serve.sh). Without a pinned key there, the catalog's key is trusted the first time, after the user checks its fingerprint. The App Museum and the PreCentral homebrew feed are add-on catalogs the user switches on (OPEN-QUESTIONS Q65: PreCentral is plain HTTP, which the Marketplace says). Each source says the kinds of app it brings and the device classes it serves (appKinds, deviceClasses: docs/APP-STORE.md 3.17; lib/availability.json); the catalog the device ships with can switch any of them off per device class in its signed index.
